root_cause: Portal-next exposed multiple navigation authorities at the same time: a primary sidebar, a separate all-pages navigation layer and a reduced mobile shortcut navigation. This fragmented the user journey and made page discovery inconsistent.
prevention_rule: All registered portal pages must be rendered from PORTAL_SECTIONS through one canonical navigation builder. Desktop uses that tree directly in the sidebar; mobile may only render the same tree responsively. No second desktop drawer, shortcut nav or separately mounted legacy page library may become an active navigation authority.

evidence.expected: exactly one canonical page registry and navigation authority across desktop and mobile
